descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Riyadh puts you in the captain's seat over the real capital of Saudi Arabia.

THE REAL RIYADH
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Kingdom Centre, Al Faisaliah and its golden globe, KAFD and the PIF Tower, Al Majdoul, the TV Tower, the Water Tower, Masmak Fortress, Murabba Palace and the National Museum, the Ministry of Interior, King Fahd Stadium, At-Turaif in Diriyah, Wadi Hanifa and the Tuwaiq escarpment. Airports: King Khalid International and Thumamah.

A LIVING CITY
All six Riyadh Metro lines on their real tracks, SAR trains, traffic on King Fahd Road and the Ring Roads, airliners over King Khalid. At night Olaya and KAFD light up.

FLY THROUGH THE KINGDOM CENTRE
Line up on King Fahd Road and thread the sky bridge opening.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar at King Salman Park, the skyline in the doors at sunset. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
King Khalid and Thumamah approaches, a low Wadi Hanifa run past Diriyah, the Kingdom Centre, the Tuwaiq escarpment, a fighter scramble, Riyadh by night and a city tour.

ENGLISH AND ARABIC
Menus, settings, missions and messages in English or Arabic.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
